title: Baked Mac and Cheese
subtitle: extra-creamy cheddar sauce under a buttery golden crumb top
imageAlt: Baked macaroni and cheese with a golden breadcrumb top and a spoonful lifted out
servingsNote: dinner for one big eater + one hungry eater, plus 3–4 lunches

beforeYouStart.text: Heat the oven to 190°C (375°F) and butter a 9×13 baking dish.
Shred the cheese from a block — pre-shredded bags have anti-caking powder and can make the sauce grainy.
Warm the milk (microwave 2 min) so the sauce thickens smoothly with no lumps.

steps.title: Undercook the pasta
steps.text: Boil the macaroni in well-salted water 2 minutes less than the box says (it finishes in the oven). Drain and set aside.

steps.title: Make the roux
steps.text: In a large pot over medium, melt 6 tbsp butter. Whisk in the flour and cook 1–2 minutes, whisking, until bubbly but not browned.

steps.title: Thicken the sauce
steps.text: Slowly whisk in the warm milk and evaporated milk. Add the salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder and paprika. Cook, whisking and scraping the bottom, 6–8 minutes until it coats a spoon. Don't let it boil hard.

steps.title: Melt in the cheese
steps.text: Take the pot off the heat and wait 1 minute. Stir in 3 cups of the cheddar and all the mozzarella a handful at a time until smooth. Taste — it should be well seasoned.

steps.title: Combine and top
steps.text: Stir in the pasta (it will look very saucy — that's right). Pour into the buttered dish and sprinkle with the last cup of cheddar. Mix the panko, Parmesan and melted butter and scatter on top.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake uncovered at 190°C (375°F) for 20–25 minutes until bubbling at the edges and golden on top. Want it browner? Broil 1–2 minutes, watching closely.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.text: Let it rest 5–10 minutes so the sauce settles and turns extra creamy, then scoop.

fixIt.fix: The cheese got too hot. Always add it off the heat, a handful at a time, and shred from a block.
Pasta was fully cooked or baked too long. Undercook by 2 minutes and keep it saucy going in. For leftovers, add a splash of milk before reheating.
Milk went in too fast or cold. Whisk hard (or quickly use an immersion blender before the cheese goes in).
Cheese sauces need salt — add ¼ tsp at a time before the pasta goes in. Old (sharp) cheddar gives the most flavour.

saleTip: Block cheddar (400 g) drops to around $5–6 on sale at No Frills — grab two and freeze one. Evaporated milk is often under $2 a can.
swap: Mix in crispy bacon or diced cooked chicken before baking to make it a full dinner. Monterey Jack works instead of mozzarella.
leftovers: Fridge 4 days. Freezes 2 months in portions. Reheat with a splash of milk, covered, in the microwave or at 175°C (350°F) for 15–20 min.
source: Based on tested baked mac and cheese methods (roux + evaporated milk, 375°F bake — Trevor's Kitchen, America's Test Kitchen).
prepAhead: Assemble the whole dish up to 1 day ahead (stir an extra ½ cup milk into the sauce first), cover and refrigerate. Add the crumb top just before baking; bake 30–35 min at 190°C (375°F).
reheat: Add a splash of milk, cover, and microwave 1–2 min (stir halfway) or bake covered at 175°C (350°F) for 15–20 min until hot (74°C / 165°F).
